title: scope
description: Stage output contract: feasibility decision plus a minimal task plan.

blocked_reason.description: why the task is blocked, if not feasible

plan.description: ordered subtasks for the implement stage

performance.description: a short design note on speed, folded into the implement (and later) prompts: does the work touch a latency-sensitive path; the design choices that decide its speed (waits/polling, blocking calls, round trips, how components hand data to each other, what can run in parallel); what to avoid. One line for work off the hot path ('not on a latency-sensitive path' is a complete note). Optional, so outputs recorded before it existed still parse.

files.description: repo-relative paths this task expects to MODIFY (not merely read); the engine serializes tasks whose declared files collide (#377). Optional: a task that declares nothing neither defers nor blocks. An entry may be a bare path string (equivalent to mode 'rewrite') or an object declaring the edit KIND (#426): mode 'append' means the edit ONLY adds a self-contained block (a new doc section, entry or row, or a new test case) and touches no existing line, shared constant or signature in that file, so two append-declaring tasks are not serialized against each other. Mode 'rewrite' is for edits that change existing lines; default to it when unsure on a code file. A path the project marks parallel-safe is treated as 'append' whatever is declared here (#628).

implementation_budget.description: IMPLEMENT's wall-clock limit for a task SCOPE does NOT decompose (#615): 'long' (60 minutes) for a large change that must still ship whole; 'standard' or absent keeps the project default. A budget pinned at add-task or in a batch plan wins over this.

subtasks.description: optional child-task DAG; when present the current task becomes an umbrella
